## Summary

A clear description of what you would like to happen.

## Motivation

Why is this feature important? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you would like. Include any design ideas or API sketches.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or references here.

## Are You Willing to Contribute?

- [ ] I am willing to implement this feature
- [ ] I would like help implementing this
- [ ] I am only requesting this feature
